newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorco talks with Manitoba smelter labor.
newsitem.headline: Minorco talks with Manitoba smelter labor.

text.p: Management for Luxembourg-based Minorco SA said it is in the midst of negotiations for a new contract with employees at its Hudson Bay Mining and Smelting Co Ltd in northern Manitoba.
The last contract with the zinc and copper operation's 2,100 employees ended October 1, a spokeswoman for the company in Flin Flon, Manitoba said.
Negotiations will be drawn out over the next month or so because the employees are represented by eight different unions, she said. The largest is the United Steelworkers of America.
Since the company is federally regulated, there is no deadline to finalise a contract, she said.
Both the company and the unions have imposed a news blackout during the talks, she said.
Copper production from the smelter was 74,000 tonnes in 1995. Zince production was 93,000 tonnes in 1995.
